recipes.title: Mississippi roast with pepperoncini
recipes.blurb: Tangy, buttery chuck roast that shreds with a fork

steps.text: Pat the roast dry and set it in the slow cooker.
Sprinkle the ranch mix and the gravy mix over the top.
Add the butter on top, the peppers around the roast, and pour in the brine.
Cover and cook on low until the roast shreds easily.
Shred the beef in the juices with two forks.
Serve over mashed potatoes, rice or on buns.

recipes.title: Slow cooker Salisbury steak and gravy
recipes.blurb: Seasoned beef patties simmered in rich onion gravy

steps.text: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, Worcestershire, salt and pepper. Shape into 6 oval patties.
Brown the patties in a skillet, 2 minutes per side. They do not need to cook through.
Layer onion and mushrooms in the slow cooker, then top with the patties.
Whisk broth and ketchup together and pour over everything.
Cover and cook on low until patties reach 160°F inside.
Stir cornstarch into the water, mix into the gravy, and cook on high to thicken.

recipes.title: Ham and white bean soup
recipes.blurb: Smoky ham and tender white beans in a savory broth

steps.text: Drain the soaked beans and add them to the slow cooker.
Add ham, onion, carrots, celery and garlic.
Pour in the broth and water, then add the bay leaf and pepper.
Cover and cook on low until the beans are soft.
Remove the bay leaf. Mash a few beans against the side to thicken the soup.
Taste and add salt only if needed, since ham is salty.

recipes.title: Beef and barley soup
recipes.blurb: Chunks of beef, vegetables and chewy barley

steps.text: Add the beef, carrots, celery, onion and garlic to the slow cooker.
Pour in the tomatoes with their juice, broth and thyme. Season with salt and pepper.
Cover and cook on low until the beef is tender.
Stir in the barley and cook on high until it is tender.
Taste and adjust the salt before serving.

recipes.title: Swiss steak with tomatoes
recipes.blurb: Tender round steak braised with onions and peppers

steps.text: Season the steak with salt and pepper, then coat in flour.
Brown the steak in hot oil in batches, 2 minutes per side.
Put onion and pepper in the slow cooker and lay the steak on top.
Pour in tomatoes, broth and Worcestershire.
Cover and cook on low until fork tender.
Serve with mashed potatoes or buttered egg noodles.

recipes.title: Party-style BBQ meatballs
recipes.blurb: Frozen meatballs in sweet, smoky barbecue glaze

steps.text: Put the frozen meatballs in the slow cooker.
Whisk barbecue sauce, jelly, Worcestershire and garlic powder together.
Pour the sauce over the meatballs and stir to coat.
Cover and cook on low until hot throughout (165°F).
Stir gently, then keep on warm for serving with toothpicks or over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken and stuffing dinner
recipes.blurb: Chicken in creamy sauce topped with herb stuffing

steps.text: Lay the chicken in the slow cooker and season with salt and pepper.
Stir the soup and broth together and pour it over the chicken.
Cover and cook on low for 4 hours.
Scatter green beans over the chicken, then spread the dry stuffing mix on top.
Drizzle the melted butter over the stuffing.
Cook on low until chicken hits 165°F and stuffing is set.

recipes.title: Chicken fajita bowls
recipes.blurb: Peppers, onions and juicy chicken over rice

steps.text: Put the peppers and onion in the slow cooker and lay the chicken on top.
Sprinkle with fajita seasoning and pour the tomatoes over it.
Cover and cook on low until chicken is 165°F.
Shred the chicken with two forks and stir it into the peppers and juices.
Squeeze in lime juice.
Spoon over rice and top with cheese.

recipes.title: Italian sausage and tortellini soup
recipes.blurb: Hearty tomato soup with spinach and cheese tortellini

steps.text: Brown the sausage in a skillet until no pink remains.
Add sausage, onion, garlic, tomatoes, broth and Italian seasoning to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low.
Stir in the tortellini and cook on high until tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Top bowls with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Slow cooker chili mac
recipes.blurb: Beefy chili stirred with macaroni and cheddar

steps.text: Brown the beef and onion until no pink remains, about 8 minutes. Drain the fat.
Add to the slow cooker with beans, tomato sauce, tomatoes, chili powder, cumin, broth and salt.
Cover and cook on low.
Stir in the macaroni and cook on high until tender.
Stir in half the cheddar and top with the rest.

recipes.title: Apple cider pork loin
recipes.blurb: Sliced pork loin with sweet apples and onions

steps.text: Season the pork with salt and pepper and rub with mustard.
Put the onion and apples in the slow cooker and set the pork on top.
Pour the cider around it and sprinkle with brown sugar and thyme.
Cover and cook on low until the center reads 145°F.
Rest the pork on a cutting board before slicing.
Slice and spoon the apples and juices over the top.

recipes.title: Bacon corn chowder
recipes.blurb: Creamy potato chowder with sweet corn and bacon

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a skillet until crisp, then set aside on paper towels.
Add potatoes, onion, 3 cups corn, broth, thyme, salt and pepper to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low until the potatoes are tender.
Mash some potatoes lightly, then stir in milk, cream cheese and the remaining corn.
Cook on high until hot and creamy.
Top with the bacon.

recipes.title: Instant Pot spaghetti with meat sauce
recipes.blurb: Pasta and meat sauce cooked together in one pot

steps.text: Set the pot to sauté. Brown the beef and onion until no pink remains, then stir in garlic.
Pour in the water and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom.
Lay the spaghetti on top in a crisscross. Pour the marinara over it without stirring.
Seal and cook on high pressure.
Quick release the steam, then stir well.
Stir in Parmesan and let it sit to thicken.

recipes.title: Instant Pot macaroni and cheese
recipes.blurb: Creamy stovetop-style mac with only 4 minutes of pressure

steps.text: Put the macaroni, water, 1 cup milk, butter, mustard and salt in the pot. Stir once.
Seal and cook on high pressure for 4 minutes.
Quick release the steam and open the lid.
Stir in the remaining milk and both cheeses a handful at a time until smooth.
Let it stand to thicken, then serve.

recipes.title: Instant Pot chicken and rice
recipes.blurb: Tender chicken thighs and seasoned rice in one pot

steps.text: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika and garlic powder.
Sauté the chicken in the oil 2 minutes per side, then remove it.
Sauté the onion and garlic in the same pot.
Add the broth and scrape the bottom. Stir in the rice, then set the chicken on top.
Seal and cook on high pressure.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then release the rest.
Check the chicken reads 165°F. Fluff the rice with the peas and serve.

recipes.title: Instant Pot pot roast with gravy
recipes.blurb: Fork-tender chuck roast ready in about an hour and a half

steps.text: Season the roast with salt and pepper.
Sauté in oil until browned on all sides.
Pour in the broth and Worcestershire and scrape the bottom. Add onion, potatoes and carrots.
Seal and cook on high pressure.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then release the rest.
Move the meat and vegetables to a platter. Set the pot to sauté.
Stir cornstarch into the water, whisk into the juices, and simmer for gravy.

recipes.title: Chicken pot pie soup
recipes.blurb: All the pot pie flavor, topped with biscuit crumbles

steps.text: Sauté onion, carrots and celery in the butter, then sprinkle in the flour and stir 1 minute.
Add broth, potatoes, thyme, salt, pepper and the whole chicken breasts.
Seal and cook on high pressure.
Quick release. Check the chicken reads 165°F and shred it back into the pot.
Stir in the milk and peas and simmer on sauté until thickened.
Serve in bowls with crumbled baked biscuits on top.

recipes.title: Shredded beef tacos
recipes.blurb: Chili-spiced beef that shreds easily after pressure cooking

ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green chiles (10 oz)

steps.text: Rub the beef with chili powder, cumin, garlic powder and salt.
Put onion, tomatoes with chiles and broth in the pot. Add the beef.
Seal and cook on high pressure.
Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes, then release the rest.
Shred the beef in the pot and stir it into the juices.
Serve in shells with cheese and your favorite toppings.

recipes.title: Weeknight Instant Pot beef chili
recipes.blurb: Hearty chili with beans, ready in under an hour

steps.text: Brown the beef with onion and pepper on sauté until no pink remains.
Stir in garlic, chili powder and cumin for 30 seconds.
Add beans, broth and salt, then pour the tomatoes on top. Do not stir.
Seal and cook on high pressure.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then release the rest.
Stir well and serve.

recipes.title: Split pea soup with ham
recipes.blurb: Thick, smoky green pea soup

steps.text: Put the split peas, ham, onion, carrots, celery and garlic in the pot.
Add the broth, bay leaf and pepper.
Seal and cook on high pressure.
Let the pressure release naturally.
Remove the bay leaf and stir hard to break up the peas.
Season with salt only if needed, since ham is salty.

recipes.title: Cheesy taco pasta
recipes.blurb: Seasoned beef, pasta and melted cheddar

ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green chiles (10 oz)

steps.text: Brown the beef on sauté until no pink remains, then stir in the taco seasoning.
Add pasta, tomatoes with chiles, tomato sauce and broth. Stir, then press the pasta under the liquid.
Seal and cook on high pressure for 4 minutes.
Quick release the steam and stir well.
Stir in the cheese until melted and serve.

recipes.title: Hamburger stroganoff
recipes.blurb: Creamy beef, mushrooms and egg noodles

steps.text: Brown the beef, mushrooms and onion on sauté until no pink remains, then add garlic.
Pour in broth and Worcestershire and scrape the bottom. Stir in the noodles.
Seal and cook on high pressure for 4 minutes.
Quick release. Stir in the cream cheese and sour cream until creamy.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken fajita rice
recipes.blurb: Seasoned chicken, peppers and rice in one pot

ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green chiles (10 oz)

steps.text: Sauté the chicken, peppers and onion in the oil.
Stir in the fajita seasoning, rice and broth and scrape the bottom well.
Pour the tomatoes over the top. Do not stir.
Seal and cook on high pressure.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then release the rest.
Check the chicken reads 165°F. Stir, top with cheese and let it melt.

recipes.title: Instant Pot chicken Alfredo penne
recipes.blurb: Creamy garlic Parmesan pasta with chicken

steps.text: Put chicken, penne, broth, garlic, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper in the pot. Stir.
Seal and cook on high pressure for 5 minutes.
Quick release the steam. Check the chicken reads 165°F.
Set to sauté. Stir in butter, cream and Parmesan.
Simmer, stirring, until the sauce is thick.

recipes.title: Instant Pot meatloaf and potatoes
recipes.blurb: Glazed meatloaf and tender potatoes cooked together

steps.text: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, 1/4 cup ketchup, onion, Worcestershire, salt and pepper. Shape into a loaf.
Pour water into the pot and set the trivet in. Put the loaf on a foil sling on the trivet.
Spread the remaining ketchup on top. Tuck the potatoes around the loaf.
Seal and cook on high pressure.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then release the rest.
Check the loaf reads 160°F. Rest before slicing.

recipes.title: Swedish-style meatballs in gravy
recipes.blurb: Frozen meatballs in creamy gravy over noodles

steps.text: Put the frozen meatballs, broth, Worcestershire, nutmeg and pepper in the pot.
Seal and cook on high pressure.
Quick release the steam. Set the pot to sauté.
Stir cornstarch into the water, add to the pot, and simmer until thick.
Turn off the heat and stir in the sour cream.
Serve over buttered noodles.

recipes.title: Instant Pot BBQ pork ribs
recipes.blurb: Tender baby back ribs, finished under the broiler

steps.text: Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Rub it on both sides of the ribs.
Pour the water and vinegar into the pot and set the trivet in. Stand the ribs on the trivet.
Seal and cook on high pressure.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then release the rest.
Move the ribs to a foil-lined pan and brush with barbecue sauce.
Broil 4 inches from the heat until sticky.

recipes.title: Garlic herb chicken thighs and red potatoes
recipes.blurb: Crispy-skinned chicken roasted on a bed of potatoes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper and spread on a sheet pan.
Rub the chicken with the remaining oil, garlic, Italian seasoning, paprika, salt and pepper. Set it on the potatoes.
Roast until the chicken reaches 165°F and the skin is crisp.
Squeeze lemon over everything and serve.

recipes.title: Meatball and broccoli bake
recipes.blurb: Frozen meatballs, broccoli and melty mozzarella

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the broccoli with oil, garlic powder and salt and spread to one side of a sheet pan.
Put the meatballs on the other side. Spoon marinara over them.
Bake until the meatballs are hot throughout (165°F).
Sprinkle mozzarella over the meatballs.
Bake until the cheese melts.

recipes.title: Maple pork chops with sweet potatoes
recipes.blurb: Sweet-savory glazed chops with roasted sweet potato

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss sweet potatoes with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper. Spread on a sheet pan.
Roast the sweet potatoes first.
Whisk the syrup, mustard, thyme and remaining oil. Season the chops with salt and pepper.
Push potatoes aside, add the chops and brush with half the glaze.
Roast until the pork reaches 145°F.
Brush with the rest of the glaze and rest 3 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Kielbasa with cabbage and potatoes
recipes.blurb: Smoky sausage with caramelized cabbage

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper. Spread on a large sheet pan.
Roast the potatoes first.
Toss cabbage and kielbasa with the remaining oil and garlic powder.
Add them to the pan and stir with the potatoes.
Roast until the cabbage is browned and tender.
Serve with mustard on the side.

recipes.title: Gnocchi with tomatoes and mozzarella
recipes.blurb: Crispy gnocchi, burst tomatoes and basil

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss gnocchi, tomatoes, oil, garlic, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper on a sheet pan.
Roast until gnocchi are golden and tomatoes burst.
Dot the mozzarella on top.
Bake until the cheese is soft and melty.
Scatter basil on top and serve.

recipes.title: Ranch chicken with green beans and potatoes
recipes.blurb: Crispy ranch-seasoned chicken with vegetables

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper and spread on a sheet pan.
Roast the potatoes first.
Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp oil and the ranch mix. Toss the beans with the remaining oil.
Add the chicken and beans to the pan.
Roast until the chicken reaches 165°F.

recipes.title: Salmon with asparagus and baby potatoes
recipes.blurb: A full dinner on one pan with lemon butter

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss potatoes with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper and spread on a sheet pan.
Roast the potatoes first.
Toss the asparagus with the remaining oil. Mix the butter, garlic and juice of half the lemon.
Push potatoes aside. Add asparagus and salmon, season, and brush the salmon with the butter.
Roast until the salmon flakes and reaches 145°F.
Cut the other lemon half in wedges and serve.

recipes.title: Italian chicken with zucchini and tomatoes
recipes.blurb: Herby chicken breasts with Parmesan vegetables

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss zucchini and tomatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper and spread on a sheet pan.
Rub the chicken with remaining oil, Italian seasoning, garlic, salt and pepper. Lay on the pan.
Roast until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Bake until the cheese melts.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger sliders
recipes.blurb: Baked beef sliders with melty cheese and buttery tops

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Cook the beef with salt, pepper and garlic powder in a skillet until no pink remains (160°F). Drain.
Slice the rolls as one sheet. Put the bottoms on a sheet pan and spread with ketchup.
Layer on the beef, cheese and pickles. Add the tops.
Brush with butter and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake until the cheese melts and tops are golden.

recipes.title: Garlic butter shrimp with corn and zucchini
recipes.blurb: Quick-roasted shrimp in garlic butter

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the corn and zucchini with half the butter, salt and pepper on a sheet pan.
Roast the vegetables.
Toss the shrimp with the remaining butter, garlic, paprika, salt and pepper.
Add the shrimp to the pan.
Roast until the shrimp are pink and opaque.
Squeeze lemon over the top and serve.

recipes.title: Crispy chicken tenders and potato wedges
recipes.blurb: Oven-crisp panko chicken with seasoned wedges

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the wedges with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper and spread on a sheet pan.
Roast the wedges first.
Mix panko, Parmesan, garlic powder, paprika and 1 tbsp oil. Dip tenders in flour, egg, then crumbs.
Move the wedges over and add the tenders to the pan.
Bake until golden and the chicken reaches 165°F.

recipes.title: Philly cheesesteak peppers and steak
recipes.blurb: Steak, peppers and onions topped with provolone

steps.text: Heat the oven to 450°F.
Toss peppers and onion with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on a sheet pan.
Roast the vegetables first.
Toss the steak with the remaining oil, Worcestershire, salt and pepper.
Add the steak to the pan and roast until browned and cooked through.
Top with provolone and bake until melted.
Pile the filling into toasted hoagie rolls.

recipes.title: Parmesan cod with roasted broccoli
recipes.blurb: Flaky cod under a golden Parmesan crust

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss broccoli with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper and spread on a sheet pan.
Roast the broccoli first.
Mix panko, Parmesan, butter, garlic powder and the remaining oil.
Add the cod to the pan, season, and press the crumbs onto the fillets.
Bake until the fish flakes and reaches 145°F.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Cheesy chicken and rice skillet
recipes.blurb: Tender chicken, rice and broccoli under melted cheddar

steps.text: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and paprika.
Heat the oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high. Brown the chicken 4 minutes, then set it aside.
Cook the onion in the same pan 3 minutes. Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and broth and scrape up the browned bits. Bring to a boil.
Return the chicken, cover, and simmer on low until the rice is nearly tender.
Scatter the broccoli on top, cover, and cook 5 more minutes. Chicken must reach 165°F.
Sprinkle with the cheddar, cover, and let melt 2 minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: One-pot sausage and pepper penne
recipes.blurb: Italian sausage, sweet peppers and penne in one tomato-y pan

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large deep pot over medium-high. Brown the sausage, breaking it up, 6 minutes.
Add the peppers and onion. Cook 4 minutes until softening.
Stir in the garlic and Italian seasoning for 30 seconds.
Pour in the tomatoes and water. Add salt and pepper and the penne. Bring to a boil.
Reduce to a steady simmer, uncovered, stirring often until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the parmesan. Sausage should be 160°F. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger macaroni skillet
recipes.blurb: Everything you love in a cheeseburger, in one pan with pasta

steps.text: Brown the beef and onion in a large deep skillet over medium-high, 6 minutes. Drain extra fat.
Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the water, tomato sauce, broth, macaroni, Worcestershire, mustard, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on medium-low, stirring a few times, until the macaroni is tender.
Beef should be 160°F. Take off the heat and stir in the cheddar until melted.
Top with chopped pickles and serve.

recipes.title: One-pot chicken fettuccine alfredo
recipes.blurb: Creamy garlic parmesan sauce made right in the pasta pot

steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high.
Cook the chicken 5 minutes until browned and 165°F inside. Remove to a plate.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then pour in the broth and milk. Bring to a boil.
Add the fettuccine, pushing it under the liquid.
Simmer, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and the liquid has mostly thickened.
Lower the heat. Stir in the cream, parmesan and chicken until the sauce is silky.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve at once.

recipes.title: Chicken enchilada rice skillet
recipes.blurb: Cheesy Tex-Mex rice with chicken, black beans and red sauce

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high. Brown the chicken and onion 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the enchilada sauce, broth, beans, corn and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 165°F.
Sprinkle with the cheese, cover, and melt 3 minutes.
Top with green onions and serve.

recipes.title: Kielbasa, potato and green bean skillet
recipes.blurb: Smoky sausage, buttery potatoes and crisp-tender beans

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large lidded skillet over medium. Add the potatoes cut-side down with salt and pepper.
Brown the potatoes 8 minutes without stirring.
Add the water, cover, and steam until a fork slips in easily.
Uncover and add the kielbasa, onion and green beans. Cook, stirring, until the water is gone.
Cook another 8 minutes until the sausage browns and the beans are crisp-tender.
Stir in the butter, garlic powder and mustard. Serve.

recipes.title: Taco macaroni skillet
recipes.blurb: Seasoned beef, pasta and melty cheese with taco night flavor

ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green chiles (10 oz)

steps.text: Brown the beef and onion in a large deep skillet over medium-high 6 minutes. Drain extra fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning and cook 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth, water and macaroni. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on medium-low, stirring a few times, until the pasta is tender.
Beef should be 160°F. Stir in half the cheese, then top with the rest and cover 2 minutes.
Serve with sour cream and crushed chips.

recipes.title: Italian sausage and orzo skillet
recipes.blurb: Savory sausage, spinach and tomatoes with creamy orzo

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high. Brown the sausage 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the onion and cook 3 minutes. Stir in the garlic and seasoning for 30 seconds.
Stir in the orzo, broth, tomatoes, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on medium-low, stirring now and then, until the orzo is tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, about 2 minutes. Sausage should be 160°F.
Stir in the parmesan and serve.

recipes.title: One-pot shrimp scampi pasta
recipes.blurb: Garlicky lemon-butter shrimp and linguine in a single pot

steps.text: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large pot over medium. Cook the garlic and pepper flakes 30 seconds.
Add the broth, water, linguine, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Boil, stirring often, until the pasta is almost tender and little liquid remains.
Nestle the shrimp in the pasta. Cook 3 minutes until pink and opaque (145°F).
Off the heat, stir in the remaining butter, lemon zest and juice, and parmesan.
Top with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Turkey chili mac
recipes.blurb: Cozy chili with macaroni cooked right in it

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high. Brown the turkey with the onion and pepper 7 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the beans, tomatoes, tomato sauce, broth and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil.
Stir in the macaroni.
Simmer, covered, stirring often, until the macaroni is tender.
Turkey should be 165°F. Top bowls with the cheddar and serve.

recipes.title: Skillet beef and potato hash with eggs
recipes.blurb: Crispy potatoes and beef topped with runny eggs

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large lidded skillet over medium-high. Add the potatoes, salt and pepper.
Cook the potatoes, stirring now and then, until golden and almost tender.
Push the potatoes aside. Add the beef, onion, pepper and paprika. Cook 6 minutes until browned and 160°F.
Stir everything together and flatten it. Make 4 wells.
Crack an egg into each well. Cover and cook until the whites are set.
Top with parsley and serve from the pan.

recipes.title: Creamy tomato tortellini skillet
recipes.blurb: Cheese tortellini in a quick tomato cream sauce with spinach

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large deep skillet over medium. Cook the garlic and seasoning 30 seconds.
Pour in the tomatoes and water. Add salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer.
Stir in the tortellini and simmer until tender and floating.
Stir in the cream and spinach until the spinach wilts.
Stir in the parmesan. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Skillet lasagna
recipes.blurb: All the lasagna flavor with broken noodles and ricotta, no oven

steps.text: Brown the sausage and onion in a large deep skillet over medium-high 7 minutes. Drain extra fat.
Stir in the garlic and seasoning for 30 seconds.
Add the marinara and water. Stir in the broken noodles, pushing them under the sauce.
Cover and simmer on medium-low, stirring a few times, until the noodles are tender.
Sausage should be 160°F. Dot the top with ricotta, then sprinkle on the mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover and cook until the cheese melts. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Air fryer chicken tenders
recipes.blurb: Crunchy panko-coated tenders with no deep frying

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Mix the panko, parmesan, garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper, then dip in flour, then egg, then the panko mix. Press to coat.
Spray the basket and arrange the tenders in a single layer. Spray the tops.
Air fry 6 minutes, flip, and spray again.
Air fry 5 to 6 more minutes until golden and 165°F inside. Cook in batches.
Serve with ketchup, honey mustard or ranch.

recipes.title: Air fryer garlic pork chops
recipes.blurb: Juicy bone-in chops with a garlicky herb rub

steps.text: Pat the chops dry. Rub with the oil, then the garlic powder, paprika, thyme, salt and pepper.
Let the chops sit 10 minutes while the air fryer preheats to 400°F.
Place the chops in a single layer in the basket.
Air fry 6 minutes, then flip.
Air fry 6 to 8 more minutes until the thickest part reaches 145°F.
Rest the chops on a plate 5 minutes. Serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Air fryer lemon-garlic salmon
recipes.blurb: Flaky salmon fillets ready in under ten minutes of cooking

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Pat the salmon dry.
Mix the oil, garlic, lemon zest, dill, paprika, butter, salt and pepper. Brush over the fillets.
Place the salmon skin-side down in the basket without touching.
Air fry 8 to 10 minutes until it flakes and reaches 145°F.
Squeeze lemon juice over the top and serve.

recipes.title: Air fryer Italian meatballs
recipes.blurb: Tender beef and pork meatballs, browned without a pan

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 380°F. Stir the breadcrumbs and milk together for 2 minutes.
Mix in the meat, egg, parmesan, garlic, seasoning, salt and pepper. Do not overmix.
Roll into 20 balls about 1.5 inches wide.
Spray the basket and place the meatballs in a single layer. Cook in 2 batches.
Air fry 10 to 12 minutes, shaking once, until browned and 160°F inside.
Toss in warm marinara and serve over pasta or in rolls.

recipes.title: Air fryer buffalo wings
recipes.blurb: Crispy wings tossed in tangy buffalo butter sauce

steps.text: Pat the wings very dry. Toss with the baking powder, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Place the wings in a single layer, working in batches.
Air fry 12 minutes, then flip.
Air fry 10 to 12 more minutes until crisp and 165°F inside.
Whisk the hot sauce and melted butter. Toss the wings in the sauce.
Serve with celery sticks and ranch.

recipes.title: Air fryer Cajun shrimp and sausage
recipes.blurb: Spicy shrimp, smoked sausage and veggies cooked together

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Toss the sausage, peppers and zucchini with half the oil and half the seasoning.
Air fry the sausage mix 8 minutes, shaking once.
Toss the shrimp with the remaining oil and seasoning.
Add the shrimp to the basket. Cook 5 to 6 minutes until pink and opaque (145°F).
Squeeze lemon over the top and serve.

recipes.title: Air fryer chicken parmesan
recipes.blurb: Crispy cutlets with marinara and melted mozzarella

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Mix the panko, parmesan and Italian seasoning.
Season the cutlets. Dip in flour, then egg, then the panko mix, pressing well.
Spray the basket and the cutlets. Cook in a single layer, in batches.
Air fry 6 minutes, flip, then 4 more minutes until golden.
Top each with marinara and mozzarella.
Air fry 2 to 3 minutes until the cheese melts and chicken is 165°F.

recipes.title: Air fryer crispy cod bites
recipes.blurb: Golden, crunchy fish pieces for dipping in tartar sauce

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Pat the cod dry and season with salt and pepper.
Mix the panko, paprika and garlic powder.
Dip the fish in flour, egg, then panko, pressing to coat.
Spray the basket and place the fish in a single layer. Spray the tops.
Air fry 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until golden and 145°F inside.
Serve with tartar sauce and lemon.

recipes.title: Air fryer chicken taquitos
recipes.blurb: Rolled corn tortillas filled with cheesy chicken, crisp outside

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Mix the chicken, cream cheese, Jack cheese, salsa and cumin.
Warm the tortillas wrapped in a damp paper towel in the microwave 30 seconds so they bend.
Spoon about 3 tablespoons filling down each tortilla and roll tightly.
Place seam-side down in the basket and spray with oil. Cook in batches.
Air fry 7 to 9 minutes until golden and crisp. Filling should be hot.
Serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Air fryer cheeseburgers
recipes.blurb: Juicy burgers with melted cheese, done in about ten minutes

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 370°F. Mix the beef with garlic powder, Worcestershire, salt and pepper.
Shape into 4 patties and press a dimple in the middle of each.
Place the patties in the basket without touching.
Air fry 8 minutes, flip, then 3 to 4 more minutes until 160°F.
Top with cheese and cook 1 minute to melt.
Serve on buns with lettuce and tomato.

recipes.title: Air fryer pepperoni pizza pockets
recipes.blurb: Homemade hand pies stuffed with cheese, pepperoni and sauce

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 360°F. Let the dough sit 10 minutes, then cut it into 4 pieces.
On a floured counter, roll each piece into a 6-inch circle.
Spoon sauce on half of each circle. Add cheese and pepperoni. Fold over and press the edges with a fork.
Brush with butter and sprinkle with Italian seasoning.
Spray the basket and place 2 pockets at a time inside.
Air fry 10 to 12 minutes, turning once, until deep golden and cooked through.
Rest 3 minutes, since the filling is very hot.

recipes.title: Air fryer herb chicken breasts
recipes.blurb: Juicy chicken with a golden herb crust, ready fast

steps.text: Pound the thick ends of the chicken so the breasts are an even thickness.
Brush with oil and rub with garlic powder, Italian seasoning, paprika, salt and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 375°F. Place the chicken in a single layer.
Air fry 10 minutes, then flip.
Air fry 8 to 10 more minutes until the thickest part reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice and serve.

recipes.title: Air fryer mini meatloaves
recipes.blurb: Little ketchup-glazed meatloaves that cook in 20 minutes

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 375°F. Mix the breadcrumbs and milk in a large bowl.
Add the beef, egg, onion, Worcestershire, 1/4 cup ketchup, salt and pepper. Mix gently.
Shape into 4 small loaves about 4 inches long. Mix the rest of the ketchup with the sugar and mustard.
Place the loaves in the basket, leaving space between them. Brush with half the glaze.
Air fry 16 minutes, then brush on the rest of the glaze.
Cook 4 to 6 more minutes until 160°F inside. Rest 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Air fryer garlic butter steak bites and potatoes
recipes.blurb: Seared steak cubes with crispy potatoes in one basket

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Toss the potatoes with the oil, paprika, salt and pepper.
Air fry the potatoes 12 minutes, shaking halfway.
Toss the steak with salt, pepper, garlic and melted butter.
Add the steak to the basket with the potatoes.
Cook 6 to 8 more minutes, shaking once, until the steak is browned and 145°F for medium.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Air fryer black bean chimichangas
recipes.blurb: Crispy burritos stuffed with beans, rice and cheese

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 380°F. Mash half the beans, then stir in the rest of the beans, rice, cheese, salsa and spices.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave 20 seconds so they fold easily.
Spoon filling in the center of each. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Spray the seams and tops with oil. Place seam-side down in the basket.
Air fry 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.
Serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Quick chicken burrito rice bowls
recipes.blurb: Seasoned chicken over rice with beans, corn and fresh toppings

steps.text: Toss the chicken with chili powder, cumin and a good pinch of salt.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high.
Cook the chicken 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until browned and 165°F.
Warm the rice, beans and corn in the microwave or a small pot.
Divide the rice among bowls. Top with chicken, beans, corn, salsa, avocado and cheese.
Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Blackened tilapia with rice
recipes.blurb: Spiced seared fish fillets served over fluffy rice with lime

steps.text: Mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, cayenne, salt and pepper.
Pat the fish dry and coat both sides with the spice mix.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high until it shimmers.
Cook the fish 3 minutes without moving it.
Flip and cook 2 to 3 more minutes until it flakes and reaches 145°F.
Serve over warm rice with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Pan-seared pork chops with pan gravy
recipes.blurb: Thin chops browned fast and finished in a savory gravy

steps.text: Season the chops with salt, pepper and half the garlic powder.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high.
Sear the chops 4 minutes per side until 145°F. Move to a plate and rest.
Lower the heat. Melt the butter in the pan, then whisk in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the broth, thyme and remaining garlic powder.
Simmer, whisking, until the gravy thickens. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Pour the gravy over the chops and serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Crispy chicken Caesar salad wraps
recipes.blurb: Crispy chicken, romaine and Caesar dressing rolled in tortillas

steps.text: Season the chicken with Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high.
Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side until golden and 165°F inside.
Slice the chicken into strips.
Toss the romaine with dressing and parmesan.
Pile the salad and chicken on the tortillas, fold in the sides, and roll up.

recipes.title: Pesto tortellini with peas
recipes.blurb: Cheese tortellini tossed with basil pesto, peas and parmesan

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Boil the tortellini according to the package, adding the peas for the last minute.
Save a half cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Return to the pot and stir in the pesto, olive oil, and a splash of pasta water.
Fold in the tomatoes and parmesan. Season with salt and pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Western omelets for dinner
recipes.blurb: Fluffy omelets with ham, peppers and cheddar, with toast

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper.
Cook the ham, pepper and onion in 1 tablespoon butter in a nonstick skillet over medium 4 minutes. Move to a bowl.
Wipe the pan, melt a little more butter, and pour in a quarter of the eggs.
Cook until the edges set, lifting them so raw egg runs underneath.
Add a quarter of the filling and cheese to one side. Fold over and slide onto a plate.
Repeat for 4 omelets. Eggs should be firm. Serve with toast.

recipes.title: Honey mustard chicken cutlets
recipes.blurb: Golden pan-fried cutlets brushed with a sweet-tangy sauce

steps.text: Season the cutlets with salt, pepper and garlic powder, then dredge in flour.
Heat the oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high.
Cook the cutlets 3 to 4 minutes per side, in batches, until golden and 165°F inside.
Move to a plate. Lower the heat and whisk the honey, mustard and vinegar in the pan 1 minute.
Return the chicken to the sauce, turn to coat, and serve.

recipes.title: Loaded beef nachos
recipes.blurb: Sheet pan nachos with seasoned beef, beans and melty cheese

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Brown the beef in a skillet over medium-high 6 minutes. Drain extra fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning and water. Simmer 3 minutes. Beef should be 160°F.
Spread the chips on a large baking sheet. Top with the beef and beans, then the cheese.
Bake until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Top with salsa, sour cream, avocado and green onions. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Garlic butter steak with green beans
recipes.blurb: Seared sirloin and tender green beans in one skillet

steps.text: Pat the steak dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat.
Sear the steak in a single layer 4 minutes, turning, until browned and 145°F for medium. Move to a plate.
Add the green beans and water. Cover and steam 4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Uncover, add the butter and garlic, and cook 1 minute.
Return the steak to the pan, toss with the parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Stovetop mac and cheese with broccoli
recipes.blurb: Creamy cheddar mac with tender broccoli, all on the stove

steps.text: Boil the macaroni in salted water.
Add the broccoli for the last 2 minutes, then drain both well.
In the same pot, melt the butter over medium. Whisk in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the milk. Simmer 3 minutes until slightly thick.
Off the heat, stir in the cheddar, mustard powder, salt and pepper until smooth.
Fold in the macaroni and broccoli and serve.

recipes.title: Skillet chicken caprese
recipes.blurb: Seared cutlets topped with tomatoes, mozzarella and basil

steps.text: Season the cutlets with Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high.
Cook the chicken 4 minutes per side until golden and 165°F. Move to a plate.
Cook the tomatoes and garlic in the pan 2 minutes until they start to burst.
Return the chicken to the pan and top with mozzarella.
Cover and cook on low until the cheese melts.
Top with basil and a drizzle of balsamic. Serve.
